articles.summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited (NYSE:PLGO) ("Pelagos Insurance Capital" or the "Company"), an expert capital allocator and risk selector in specialty insurance and reinsurance, announced today that it expects to release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 11, 2026, after the close of the financial markets. These documents will be available via the Investors section of the Company’s website at https://investors.pelagosinsurancecapital.com . Dan Burrows, Group Chief Executive Officer, Allan Decleir, Group Chief Financial Officer, and Jonny Strickle, Group Managing Director, will host an investor teleconference, including a question-and-answer session, on November 12, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET to discuss the third quarter results as well as related matters. The teleconference can be accessed by dialing +1-833-470-1428 (U.S. callers), or +1-646-844-6383 (international callers), and entering the passcode 187208 approximately 10 minutes in advance of
articles.title: Pelagos Insurance Capital Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call
